scoring_justification: Cannot re-run TD-DFT in verifier; scores reported values against paper's reported values with tolerances and structural checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for excitation energies, relaxation energy, ZPL, symmetries, and polarization rules from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Fig. 1: neutral lowest excitation ~2.0 eV, negative ^4A_2 at 1.568 eV, ^4E at 1.572 eV, relaxation energy ~0.1 eV, estimated ZPL ~1.47 eV; symmetries and polarization rules as described.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported numbers and textual descriptions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly reported in the paper and are the target of the reproduction; they are not invented.

outputs.description: JSON artifact containing the computed excitation energies, symmetries, polarisation rules, relaxation energy, estimated zero‑phonon line, and a comparison statement against experimental V1/V1' photoluminescence data.

output_contract.notes: All numeric energies are in eV. Polarisation strings indicate optical selection rules relative to the defect symmetry axis. The comparison statement must honestly evaluate, based on the computed numbers, whether the properties of the neutral and negatively charged vacancies are consistent with the experimental V1/V1' PL data.

steps.description: Validates numeric quantities, symmetry strings, polarization rules, and comparison statement
